mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the sensory and motor routes was most worthwhile: the planned cutaways locate the sensory ganglion and motor cell bodies and show where their pathways join.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling four central regions with the same neural tissue became predictable, although the resulting functional insets added useful context.

surprise.text: The spinal cord cutaway showed a sensory input branching to both a local motor circuit and an ascending pathway, rather than only travelling toward the brain.

arbitrary.text: Using the same generic neural tissue to complete several anatomically distinct regions felt somewhat schematic; the plans showed their structures but did not explain how the tissue acquired each region’s identity.
